einzeiler: Decades after a young mother's poisoning, new questions surround her husband Ray McQueen.
kurzfassung: In 1986, Rosalind McQueen died suddenly at her home, and initial police assumptions of natural causes were shattered when toxicology reports revealed a fatal dose of strychnine. Decades later, investigative journalist Hedley Thomas revisits the case, uncovering suspicious behavior by her husband Ray, a secretive relationship with a teenage girl, and deep-seated local doubts. Neighbors and family members continue to search for answers, believing the tragic double murder of Rosalind and her unborn son was never properly resolved.
stichpunkte: Rosalind McQueen died on April 1, 1986, at her home in Lockwood, Victoria, while her husband Ray was away at work.
Initial responding police and ambulance officers noted unusual circumstances, but failed to treat the scene as suspicious.
An autopsy initially proved inconclusive, but toxicology tests returned months later showing a fatal dose of strychnine.
Police confronted Ray McQueen in June 1986, prompting him to claim his wife was depressed and suffered from cancer.
Neighbors, friends, and Rosalind's family strongly disputed Ray's claims of depression and pointed to his close relationship with a teenager named Donna.
Despite a subsequent inquest and murder trial in the late 1980s, no verdict was reached, leaving the case unresolved.
Investigator Rex Bakes has spent years trying to uncover the truth, supported by local residents who remain convinced of foul play.

clips.hook: A chilling discovery in the kitchen
clips.text: A neighbor recounts entering the house and finding the victim slumped over a kitchen chair, realizing immediately that she had passed away.

clips.hook: A GP refuses to sign the death certificate
clips.text: The victim's doctor declined to certify the death because he considered her to be a completely healthy woman.
Detectives inform the husband that laboratory analysis proved his wife ingested a lethal amount of strychnine.
The narrative reveals that the lethal poison also claimed the life of the unborn child the victim was carrying.
A neighbor recalls watching the husband burn all of the deceased woman's clothes shortly after her burial.

beschreibung:
Documents from the brief of evidence reveal that when police ask Ray McQueen whether he has any idea why his wife died at the kitchen table, he tells them “Yes, she’s had cancer”.
Police decide there are no suspicious circumstances, but her general practitioner refuses to provide a death certificate. Almost three months later, toxicology tests show strychnine killed Rosslyn.
Hedley Thomas, Karina Berger and Rex Bakes meet in Bendigo for new interviews and investigations.
